data.raw_text:
[5:00PM] #CBD_Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is currently flowing smoothly from Carter Bridge toward Eyin Eyo and en route to Martins Street.

However, the return journey from Tinubu Square connecting Nnamdi Azikiwe Street up to the Tom Jones intersection is experiencing slow movement, primarily due to ongoing market activities in the area.

The Oyebanji intersection, linking Adeniji Adele Road through the Oba’s Palace and Police Post, is clear and moving well at this time.

Traffic from Ilubinrin connecting Carter Bridge inbound Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo, is also moving steadily with no cause for concern.

Other areas within the zone remain calm and free of obstructions. Our personnel are actively present at key choke points, effectively managing and directing the flow of vehicles.

#FollowLASTMA
